name: MIPLIB 2017 open instance dws012-03
description: Find a feasible solution of the MIPLIB 2017 instance dws012-03 with as low an objective value as possible (a maximisation model is negated, so that lower is better for every instance). A solution is feasible when every variable bound, every row bound and the integrality of every integer variable hold within an absolute tolerance of 1e-6 on the values as they are returned; integer variables are not rounded first.
contract: solve(model) -> numpy array of num_cols values, one per column. model has name, mps_path (the uncompressed MPS file), num_cols, num_rows, A (scipy CSR matrix of the rows), col_cost, col_lower, col_upper, row_lower, row_upper, integrality (bool array), offset, maximise and indicators (a list of (row, column, value): such a row has to hold only when that column equals the value; empty for most instances). Score: col_cost @ x + offset in minimisation form (negated when maximise is true), minimized; an infeasible vector is invalid.
notes: Listed objective 140473.57648986066 (in the model's own sense).

Design of a decentralised drinking-water supply system for a skyscraper (pump layout and continuous pump speeds over load scenarios, pump curves modelled by an aggregated convex combination), submitted by Philipp Leise; the instances differ in the number of floors and load scenarios.
